dialogueLines.line: Silence, creature. I am superior to you.
dialogueLines.speaker: prisma

dialogueLines.line: Zoinks! I don't like your dimension, man.
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: Like, are you made of paper or something?
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy

dialogueLines.line: I am a perfect 2D being, not your toy.
dialogueLines.speaker: prisma

dialogueLines.line: Zoinks! Your voice echoes, like, a lot.
dialogueLines.speaker: shaggy
